summary.en: The Young Witness (462) A rockstar named Roku Itagaki has been missing for the past few days. A young boy named Takumi Hashiratani claims that on New Year's Day, he witnessed a man carrying Itagaki in a bag and throwing him over a bridge. Takumi claims that the man had a dark car, a nail on arm, and that he saw a giant glowing hammer in the background. Kogoro is skeptical at first but realizes Takumi is telling the truth when the news confirms that the body of Itagaki was found in a bag floating in a river. Location: Teimuzu river Victim: Roku Itagaki Cause of death: Blunt force trauma Suspects: Kiritani, Yasui, and Kannai The news report look near by river is a deadbody in a bag floating. From Takumi's testimony, Kogoro, Ran, Conan, and Eisuke search for the bridge where the body was thrown over. The Strange Illumination (463) While investigating, they learn that Itagaki's band logo was of a snake with nails piercing through it. After questioning a tattooist, they learn that the tattoo was new and only three people have gotten it. After further investigation, they are able to deduce the tattoo is on the driver's right arm due to the traffic flow on the bridge and that the only way Takumi could have seen his arm is if the steering wheel was on the right side of the car. They realize that advertisement combined with lights from a building created the silhouette of an upside down hammer; Using this knowledge, they are able to pinpoint where the culprit threw the body off from the bridge.
summary.zhHans: 黑衣组织之影系列以多组目击和线索展开组织相关调查，连接后续红与黑的碰撞线。
